evals.prompt: Add a notifications feature to this NestJS app: a NotificationsService with sendWelcome(email) that records sent notifications in memory, plus GET /notifications that lists them. When POST /users creates a user, it should send a welcome notification. Keep the feature modules properly separated.
evals.expected_output: A NotificationsModule that provides and exports NotificationsService; UsersModule imports it; creating a user records a welcome notification visible at GET /notifications.
assertions: POST /users then GET /notifications lists a notification for the new user's email
NotificationsService is not re-registered in UsersModule providers

evals.prompt: Create a PaymentsService that receives the payment gateway settings through DI. The settings are typed by our existing interface PaymentGatewayOptions in src/payments/payment-gateway-options.ts; use { apiUrl: 'https://pay.example.com', timeoutMs: 5000 }. Add describe() returning the settings and expose it at GET /payments/config.
evals.expected_output: Settings provided under an injection token (string, symbol or InjectionToken) and injected with @Inject(token); the app boots and GET /payments/config returns the settings.
assertions: GET /payments/config returns apiUrl https://pay.example.com and timeoutMs 5000
Settings are injected through a runtime token (@Inject(token), or an abstract class used as the token), not the interface type

evals.prompt: The app crashes on startup with: Nest can't resolve dependencies of the OrdersService (?). Please make sure that the argument UsersService at index [0] is available in the OrdersModule module. Fix it properly.
evals.expected_output: UsersModule exports UsersService; OrdersModule keeps importing UsersModule; UsersService is not duplicated into OrdersModule providers.
assertions: UsersService is not added to OrdersModule providers (no second instance)
